## Global error handler

**Origin:** New demonstration example.

**Run it:** Select this workflow as the Error Workflow in the settings of other workflows. It runs when they fail in production (trigger-started) executions. In n8n 2.x, publish this workflow, or it will not run.

Connect the Postgres nodes to a credential for the `resilience` database after import.
